Author: kittenhaswares-ui
Name: Seiton Sense
Punchline: Stable PvP nameplate indicators for Seiton, Guard, and low MP.
Description: A display-only Crystalline Conflict HUD for every job. Extra icons are anchored beside native enemy job icons; observed Guard cooldown and low MP are shown for everyone, while Ninja gets an exact S1-S5 Seiton popup.
Changelog: Rebuilt the overlay around FFXIV's native nameplate job-icon bounds to remove world-projection jitter. Added all-job crossed Guard-cooldown and low-MP elixir indicators. Ninja now gets a configurable job-icon + exact S1-S5 popup with stable readiness logic that ignores transient facing/action-lock noise.
